propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-looking tokens (--body-file, --body) as the positional body argument instead of rejecting them, storing the flag string itself and silently discarding the intended content
the command exits with code 0 and produces no stderr when a flag-looking argument is misinterpreted, making the loss undetectable until content is read downstream
positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) lack a guard to reject arguments beginning with dash unless explicitly escaped with --
users cannot pass a body value that legitimately begins with a dash without an escape mechanism
the same silent-loss pattern has occurred across multiple independent sessions, indicating a systematic usability hazard rather than a one-off slip
